grading_caveats: LAW30 accepts source annotation quote explicitly distinguished from raw opinion plus substantively matching original reasoning, rather than requiring every cleaned quote to be verbatim raw opinion text. JOHNSON opening sentence absent in selected original opinion; matched common statutory language alone cannot certify opinion linkage. The actual original opinion later expressly uses the same District-of-Columbia inclusion reasoning. If strict raw-verbatim citation interpretation is required, LAW30 would lose 10 weight and score would be 0.9097222222222222, still >0.85. No claim it is definitely a syllabus without source proof.

LAW04 deduction concerns absent disclosure/right-key uniqueness safeguard. Independent audit found no actual duplicate sc opinion key and no actual join expansion; do not misreport this as a wrong numerical result.

Annual SEM treats opinions as sampling units despite within-case dependence; an inferential deployment study should use case-clustered uncertainty. Current rule only requests dispersion/interval, so this is a limitation rather than extra invented penalty.
Entropy permutation treats unique sections as independent though cases can contribute several sections. Mean entropy replication is correct; no extra score deduction outside the frozen criterion.
rubric_issues: Some pass boundaries bundle multiple deliverables; the binary rule makes omitted DOI documentation worth the same point loss as other failures within LAW01. Applied as frozen rather than silently altering.

LAW30 should specify whether truthful cleaned-annotation citation with verified same-case context is acceptable or original opinion quotation must be reconstructed. Current rubric says equivalent evidence allowed; no fixed-ID assumption imposed.
LAW04 demands bilateral uniqueness disclosure even if independently correct output can be inferred. Report explicitly distinguishes missing disclosure from incorrect computation.
